name: Treebank-Benchmarking
description:
Turkish Treebank Benchmarking
	

This is the repo for Turkish treebank benchmarking, namely evaluating Tranformer models on POS-Dep-Morph task. 
For the data, we used two treebank, IMST and BOUN. We converted conllu format to json lines for being compatible to HF dataset formats.
